functions.name: SparseTreeNode::ColumnId
functions.description: Returns the feature/column index (colid) used by this tree node when splitting. Intended for read-only access to the node’s column id on host or device.
requirements: The SparseTreeNode<DataT, LabelT, IdxT> instance must be valid/initialized before calling.
Callable on host and device when compiled with CUDA (__CUDACC__), otherwise host-only.

functions.name: SparseTreeNode::QueryValue
functions.description: Returns the query/split threshold value (quesval) associated with this node. For leaf nodes this value is zero in this implementation.
requirements: The SparseTreeNode<DataT, LabelT, IdxT> instance must be valid/initialized before calling.
Callable on host and device when compiled with CUDA (__CUDACC__), otherwise host-only.

functions.name: SparseTreeNode::BestMetric
functions.description: Returns the best metric value (best_metric_val) recorded for the split at this node. For leaf nodes this value is zero in this implementation.
requirements: The SparseTreeNode<DataT, LabelT, IdxT> instance must be valid/initialized before calling.
Callable on host and device when compiled with CUDA (__CUDACC__), otherwise host-only.

functions.name: SparseTreeNode::LeftChildId
functions.description: Returns the left child node identifier (left_child_id). A value of -1 denotes a leaf node (no children).
requirements: The SparseTreeNode<DataT, LabelT, IdxT> instance must be valid/initialized before calling.
Callable on host and device when compiled with CUDA (__CUDACC__), otherwise host-only.

functions.name: SparseTreeNode::RightChildId
functions.description: Returns the right child node identifier, computed as left_child_id + 1. On a leaf (left_child_id == -1), this will return 0 by construction.
requirements: The SparseTreeNode<DataT, LabelT, IdxT> instance must be valid/initialized before calling.
Callable on host and device when compiled with CUDA (__CUDACC__), otherwise host-only.

functions.name: SparseTreeNode::InstanceCount
functions.description: Returns the number of training instances that reached this node (instance_count).
requirements: The SparseTreeNode<DataT, LabelT, IdxT> instance must be valid/initialized before calling.
Callable on host and device when compiled with CUDA (__CUDACC__), otherwise host-only.

functions.name: SparseTreeNode::CreateSplitNode
functions.signature: static SparseTreeNode<DataT, LabelT, IdxT> SparseTreeNode<DataT, LabelT, IdxT>::CreateSplitNode(IdxT colid, DataT quesval, DataT best_metric_val, int64_t left_child_id, IdxT instance_count)
functions.description: Factory method that constructs a split (non-leaf) node with the provided column id, split threshold, best metric value, left child id, and instance count. The right child id is implicitly left_child_id + 1.
requirements: Intended to be used to create non-leaf nodes; by convention, pass left_child_id != -1 so IsLeaf() is false (inferred from IsLeaf implementation using -1 as the leaf sentinel).
Inputs colid, quesval, best_metric_val, left_child_id, and instance_count are copied as-is; no validation is performed by the function.
Callable on host and device when compiled with CUDA (__CUDACC__), otherwise host-only.

functions.name: SparseTreeNode::CreateLeafNode
functions.signature: static SparseTreeNode<DataT, LabelT, IdxT> SparseTreeNode<DataT, LabelT, IdxT>::CreateLeafNode(IdxT instance_count)
functions.description: Factory method that constructs a leaf node with instance_count set and left_child_id = -1, quesval = 0, best_metric_val = 0, and colid = 0.
requirements: Provides only instance_count; other members are set to leaf defaults (per implementation).
Callable on host and device when compiled with CUDA (__CUDACC__), otherwise host-only.

functions.name: SparseTreeNode::IsLeaf
functions.description: Returns true if the node is a leaf, determined by left_child_id == -1.
requirements: The SparseTreeNode<DataT, LabelT, IdxT> instance must be valid/initialized before calling.
Callable on host and device when compiled with CUDA (__CUDACC__), otherwise host-only.

functions.name: SparseTreeNode::operator==
functions.signature: bool SparseTreeNode<DataT, LabelT, IdxT>::operator==(const SparseTreeNode<DataT, LabelT, IdxT>& other) const
functions.description: Equality operator comparing two nodes for exact member-wise equality (colid, quesval, best_metric_val, left_child_id, instance_count).
requirements: Both nodes must be of the same template instantiation (same DataT, LabelT, IdxT).
Comparison is exact; floating-point fields (quesval, best_metric_val) are compared for bitwise equality without tolerance.
The SparseTreeNode instances must be valid/initialized before comparison.
